## Repositories (evidence for the claims above)

- quant-agent-cli — agent-callable, risk-first CLI: JSON Schema input, structured error codes, dry-run/testnet gates

- bilibili-cleaner, x-account-cleaner — bulk operations with review gates, rate limits, idempotent deletes
- PromptPanel — native macOS prompt/snippet launcher, local-first (Swift/SwiftUI)
